A deload is a planned easier week where you cut back the training load, usually by lowering the weight, the sets, or both, while still showing up and moving. The point is to let fatigue clear so you come back fresher and can keep progressing, instead of grinding into a stall.

Most people deload every 4 to 8 weeks, or sooner if lifts keep slipping and everything feels heavy. It's not time off and it's not a failure; it's part of the plan. If you'd like, I can look at where you are in your program and tell you whether one makes sense soon.
